hypothesis: Prior-day 13Z NBM is published before the 18-hour market cutoff and contains complete f35 probabilistic MaxT fields for all 12 US station regimes on three seasonally separated dates, providing a six-hour fresher forecast candidate than 07Z f41.

probe.valid_time: target date plus one day at 00Z
probe.decision_cutoff: target date minus one day at 18:00Z
probe.station_duplicate_rule: only complete byte-identical duplicates may be canonicalized

decision_rule.pass: Permit a new disjoint-date pilot comparing 13Z f35 against 07Z f41 and market; do not rescore prior validation/test.
decision_rule.fail: Reject 13Z as a scalable candidate and do not download a larger cohort.
